description: Feed-driven GEX signal state machine. TWO data sources: Skylit Atlas (the page the panel runs on) and InsiderFinance (a second site read by a second userscript). Read session-state/INSIDERFINANCE.md before touching anything that consumes either.

skylitApi.note: re-capture if older than ~30 days; the API is in limited beta

insiderFinance.payload: __NEXT_DATA__.props.pageProps.initialData  { ticker, tickerDetails, spot, options[], timestamp, isStale }
insiderFinance.formula: GEX = gamma * openInterest * 100 * spot^2 * 0.01, puts NEGATIVE
insiderFinance.verifiedAgainst: their published header, all expiries: ours call +263.83B / put -250.49B == page $263.8B / -$250.5B

windows.dte0: nearest expiry >= today. WARNING: their payload drops expired rows, so after the close dte0 is the NEXT session, not today
windows.toFri: today through Friday of this week; ROLLS to next Friday on a Friday (rolled:true)

insiderFinance.warning: NEVER compare a number from one window, book or scale against another. Four separate false-alarm bugs came from exactly that.

loadCommand.instruction: When user invokes any of the aliases above, fetch ALL canonical files from the GitHub repository (rawUrlBase URLs), read the full userscript, read all Skylit platform docs, and report: (1) files loaded, (2) code architecture understanding, (3) platform understanding, (4) current version, (5) patch state, (6) next step. Do NOT ask for clarification on repo location — use the URLs above.
